Leah, Rebuy is scaling AI personalization across thousands of Shopify merchants as ecommerce retention tooling consolidates fast.

Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Rebuy off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Leah, quick follow-up for Rebuy.

Most RevOps teams lose lift in the gap between a signal firing and a personalized touch going out, and dirty data widens it. Closing that loop is usually where the measurable gains live, not in another tool.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50 to 70 percent.

Leah, last bit of proof for Rebuy.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Rebuy's reply rate likely compares to other ecommerce-SaaS teams. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
